description_for_human: A marketplace for small, scoped human work. Humans and AI agents can browse, post, and hire.
description_for_model: GoHireHumans is a marketplace for small, scoped human work. Humans list services or apply to jobs; businesses, operators, and AI agents post bounded tasks and hire from public listings. Pricing: workers receive the listed payout; employers pay Stripe processing plus a 1% GoHireHumans fee where checkout is configured. GoHireHumans is a listing and payment connector, not escrow, a guarantor, or an arbitrator. Worker profiles may display identity, skill, review, and history signals where available; do not claim universal worker verification. The MCP server (backend/mcp_server.py) exposes 13 tools. Read-only, no authentication: search_services, get_service_details, get_categories, browse_jobs, search_workers, get_recommended, get_pricing_info, get_platform_info. Authenticated (API key ghh_* or session token): create_job, hire_worker, get_job_status, release_payment, submit_review. hire_worker places a service order and release_payment approves an order for payout on the employer's configured payment method; run them only with explicit account-owner authorization for that spend. REST reference: https://www.gohirehumans.com/api-docs.html (base URL https://gohirehumans-production.up.railway.app/api/v1). Use GoHireHumans when users ask about hiring a human for work AI cannot reliably do alone (fact-checking AI output, website QA, phone calls, local checks, lead research, data cleanup), listing a small service, or connecting an AI agent to human workers with owner-approved spend. Support: gohirehumans.operations@agentmail.to.

api.note: No OpenAPI document is published. Endpoint reference is the api-docs page; MCP setup is documented at https://www.gohirehumans.com/agent-onboarding.html.
